annotations.annotation_text: The Book of Kells manuscript tradition (Monks): Joyce equates the text of Finnegans Wake and the Hen's letter to the labyrinthine Celtic interlacing and enigmatic Latin glosses of the 8th-century Gospel book.

annotations.annotation_text: The Twelve Jurors / Tavern Drinkers (Bottle): representing the chorus of public opinion, the twelve signs of the Zodiac, the Apostles, and the customers gossiping in HCE's Chapelizod pub.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas

annotations.annotation_text: The theme of the cosmic and comic Fall (fall): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattered from the wall, and Adam falling in Eden, awaiting whiskey-fuelled resurrection.
sources: The Ballad of Tim Finnegan's Wake. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finnegan%27s_Wake
